description: This file handles follow-up messaging for execution approval processes, including building prompts, formatting error messages, and sending follow-up messages via gateway or direct methods, with support for session keys and delivery targets.

methods.name: buildExecDeniedFollowupPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a prompt message indicating an async command did not run and should not be retried.

methods.name: formatUnknownError
methods.description: Formats an unknown error object into a string message.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalFollowupPrompt
methods.description: Builds a follow-up prompt message based on the result text, handling denied results distinctly.

methods.name: shouldSuppressExecDeniedFollowup
methods.description: Determines if follow-up should be suppressed based on session key type (subagent or cron).

methods.name: formatDirectExecApprovalFollowupText
methods.description: Formats the result text into a user-facing message, handling different result kinds and sanitizing output.

methods.name: buildSessionResumeFallbackPrefix
methods.description: Provides a prefix message when session resume fails.

methods.name: canDirectSendDeniedFollowup
methods.description: Checks if direct follow-up can be sent based on session error presence.

methods.name: buildAgentFollowupArgs
methods.description: Constructs arguments for sending follow-up via gateway, including delivery target and message content.

methods.name: sendDirectFollowupFallback
methods.description: Sends a direct follow-up message if gateway delivery fails or is not applicable.

methods.name: sendExecApprovalFollowup
methods.description: Main exported function to send follow-up messages for execution approval, handling gateway and direct methods, with error handling.
